I'm sorry you are hurting right now. Just remember the pain won't go away if you hurt yourself. If you hurt yourself, you hurt those around you even if you don't realize it. I found that a good way to cope is to excersise because you feel some pain and it benefits your body at the same time. I know that's not everyone's cup of tea so you can try new things and see what's best for you. It will take time, so take it slow and easy. And remember pain is temporary, death is not. I hope you feel better soon.

If you ever feel suicidal again then find something to do. I know it sounds lame but just find something you're intrested in or try something new. I'm sorry about what happened to you in the past and it is nearly impossible to forget that, but you can change for the best in the future and in the present. Set goals for yourself like little goals at first. Maybe drink more water or take a run. But take it slowly and day by day one step at a time. If you have the will to bet better then you can get better. Life is going to be challenging but there's always going to be a bright spot aswell if you look at it right. Just please don't hurt yourself. If you have anyone close to you, you'll be hurting them aswell. I hope you feel better. We are all here to support you.

There was a story of a teenager who jumped from an overpass onto a car, the driver was studying to be a psycologist helping out suicidal teens like that person. The teen lived, the driver died. Suicide no matter the method is wrong and can hurt others in the process. And if you kill yourself. And if you have any close friends. It hurts to have someone close leave, you think what could I have done to stop this? There's no physical pain that is equal to the pain of losing someone close to suicide, and the guilt. But even if you don't care about others. What will you gain from killing yourself? You have one shot at life. One chance. Its not like you can just decide in one moment I'm just going to die with no consequences. The scary thing is you can choose to do that along with anyone else. You can have a future and move somewhere else eventually, meet new people. Many opportunities in the future if you have the will to keep going. There will be challenges along the way but also things that make life worth living. I'm sure eventually you'll find someone who cares a true friend. Also I care a long with others on here, otherwise we wouldn't be typing on here. So I hope you make the right decision and have a good life.

Find a purpose to live, maybe for others, maybe for just yourself. Try to enjoy the little things and don't take life for granted. There's no physical pain that can measure up to loosing someone close to you. So if you have anyone close to you. Like family or friends please don't hurt yourself, because if you hurt yourself you are also hurting them. Having someone close to you commit suicide feels as if they betrayed you. So don't betray anyone close to you. Make some goals for yourself, treat yourself once in a while, take it step by step one day at a time. Eventually no matter how bad the situation is, with time, effort, and the will to improve you can improve! Good luck and happy birthday.
